_absolute_ids: Absolute image ids 0..5: map/image.c map_image_init_edges() stores literal ids 1..5 in the map image grid for border tiles, and city/view.c (lines 155, 803) treats any tile with map_image_at() < 6 as invisible/off-map. Therefore every drawable terrain/building image must have absolute id >= 6; recommended: id 0 = dummy, GROUP_TERRAIN_BLACK starts at id 1 (count 5, ids 1..5).

Image id 0 is "no image": tiles.c (lines 99, 238, set_rock_image, set_garden_image, set_plaza_image) test map_image_at()==0 / !map_image_at() to decide whether a tile still needs an image. No group may start at id 0.

src/map/terrain.c determine_original_trees(): reads image ids stored in scenario/save files and checks them against image_group(GROUP_TERRAIN_TREE)+8..+31. Original Caesar III .map/.sav files contain absolute ids from the original layout, so ring detection on legacy files only works if GROUP_TERRAIN_TREE has the same absolute start as in the original c3.sg2 (non-fatal if different: only TERRAIN_ORIGINALLY_TREE ring marking is affected).

GROUP_BUILDING_AQUEDUCT_NO_WATER (196) must start exactly at image_group(GROUP_BUILDING_AQUEDUCT)+15: water_supply.c compares aqueduct tile image ids against image_group(196) to decide whether to add/subtract 15 (water <-> dry). Group 196 aliases group 19 offsets 15..29; it must not get separate images, and no image of group 19 offsets 0..14 may be >= start(196). Also asset-based highway aqueduct images (>= 10000 asset ids) fall in the ">=" branch but are handled by the TERRAIN_HIGHWAY check.
